hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880211 (20 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp, water and sewer; 18 Modern Electric list 50-amp, 35 list 30-amp) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ohiopyle-state-park/stay ('Many campsites have electric hookups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 197 drive-in RV campsites on the booking site (124 Modern Non-Electric, 53 Modern Electric, 20 Full-Hookup) besides 27+ walk-to sites, tent-only sites, cottages, yurts and group tenting; DCNR says 'about 200 campsites'. Most non-electric sites take only 15 ft (13 of 124 take 23 ft or more); electric sites run 15-40 ft and full-hookup 30-50 ft. About 80 sites take 23 ft or more; 9 pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ohiopyle-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880211 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ohiopyle-state-park/stay ('Kentuck Campground has about 200 campsites'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ohiopyle-state-park/stay ('The campground has a sanitary dump station and shower houses'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked for the same day and up to 11 months ahead (ReserveAmerica booking window). DCNR: 'Advance reservations are required to ensure campsite availability.'

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ohiopyle-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880211 ('Full-Hookup ... Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance', same for Modern Electric and Non-Electric) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ohiopyle-state-park/stay, read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for Kentuck, and the April to mid-December season (already manual). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer (20 Full-Hookup sites), 197 drive-in RV sites to 50 ft with 9 pull-throughs (most non-electric sites only 15 ft), showers and dump. Not stated for this park: minimum/maximum stay, cutoff, walk-up policy (DCNR says advance reservations are required to ensure a site). Fees left at the statewide table.
flags: Missing official website: website holds only the ReserveAmerica link; add the DCNR park page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ohiopyle-state-park.
